entities.summary: Richard Garth Henning is an American Catholic prelate who serves as archbishop of Boston in Massachusetts since 2024. He previously served as bishop of Providence in Rhode Island from 2023 to 2024 and as an auxiliary bishop of Rockville Centre in New York State from 2018 to 2022.
